notes.title: Version 1.0.3 has arrived!
notes.content:
[h1]What's New: Version 1.0.3 is here![/h1]

[list]
[h3][*] Updates:[/h3]
[*] [b]Keys for basic game functions:[/b]
[list]
[*] You can use your numeric keypad keys 1 to 9 to quickly add strokes to the sequencer;
[*] You can also use Backspace to delete a move and Enter or Space to start your sequence;
[/list]
[*] [b]Added the Reset button within Options to return the options to their Default state [/b]
  
[h3][*] Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused some translations to not be implemented in some game locations;
[*] Some reported visual bugs have been fixed;
[*] Level 17 Stamina changed from 9 to 8;
[*] Fixed a bug reported by some players where the Menu stayed on screen and couldn't be removed;
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: News: Update 1.0.2 is here!
notes.content:
[h1]News: Update 1.0.2 is here![/h1]

[list]
[*] We added more visual feedback to make the learning curve smoother.
  
[*] We removed linearity from the game so you can skip a level if you get stuck.
  
[*] We also added more optional intermediate levels so you can better learn the mechanics.
  
[*] We also have more advanced levels
  
[*] We added a new playable character.
  
[*] Visual improvements to enemies and Levels.
[/list]
